web_search.description: Search the internet via Google. Used when live information, real-time facts, news, prices, or external web data is needed.
web_search.query: Search query in English or Vietnamese
web_search.num: Number of results to retrieve (1-50, default 5)

web_crawl.description: Extract full content of a web page using headless browser. Used when a specific URL needs to be read.
web_crawl.selector: CSS selector to filter specific content (optional)

http_fetch.description: Send an HTTP request to a URL (proxy). Used for REST APIs, JSON downloads, or simple webpages without JavaScript.
http_fetch.method: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE (default GET)
http_fetch.body: Request body for POST/PUT as JSON string (optional)

browser_automate.description: Automate browser actions: click, fill form, take screenshot. Used for interactive pages requiring login or form filling.
browser_automate.steps: Ordered list of steps to execute. Each step is an object: { action, selector, value }
browser_automate.action: Action: click, fill, screenshot, or wait

save_memory.description: Save critical user information to long-term memory for future conversations.

recall_memory.description: Recall all stored user memories to personalize responses.

company_dashboard_metrics.description: Read company internal business metrics through OpenClaw SSOT.
company_dashboard_metrics.period: Reporting period: today, month, quarter, or year. Default today.

schedule_manage.description: Manage user schedule via the scheduler service.
schedule_manage.operation: Operation: create, list, update, or delete.
schedule_manage.title: Reminder title or event name.
schedule_manage.repeatType: Repeat rule: none, daily, or weekly.
schedule_manage.not_found: ❌ Schedule to update was not found.

agent_loop.final_synthesis_instruction: Synthesize what you have discovered and provide the final answer.
